sentences.en: He assumed Cynthia Byrne was a few minutes late, but when he descended the stairs, there she sat, opposite Fred O'Connor, who was decked out in an elegant blue pinstripe suit complete with pocket handkerchief and bow tie.
sentences.vi: Anh cho rằng Cynthia Byrne đã đến muộn vài phút, nhưng khi anh bước xuống cầu thang, cô đã ngồi ở đó, đối diện với Fred O'Connor, người được trang điểm trong bộ vest màu xanh lam thanh lịch hoàn chỉnh với khăn tay bỏ túi và nơ.

sentences.en: A white pinstripe was introduced by Umbro ready for the last of the European cup wins in Rome 1984.

sentences.en: He always wore a suit - usually gray and double-breasted - its subtle pinstripe blotched with multicolored stains of obscure and unsavory origin.

sentences.en: Every morning, he dons his pinstripe suit and bowler hat and sets off to catch the train to work.
sentences.vi: Mỗi sáng, anh ấy mặc bộ quần áo có họa tiết sọc và đội mũ quả dưa rồi bắt tàu đi làm.

sentences.en: Try a pinstripe vertical pattern to make you look even taller!

sentences.en: Tuxedos are available in black, white, ivory, gray, and pinstripe.

sentences.en: Pink and Brown Stripe Border-This design from 1st Class Wedding Invitations features a pastel pink pinstripe, edged by a thin mocha border.

sentences.en: Midnight Trellis- The stark contrast of the feminine black floral print against a bright white background, mixed with a fine black-and-white pinstripe gives this pattern a striking, bold look perfect for a modern style bedroom.

sentences.en: For a wedding or other dressy occasion, a toddler boy pinstripe dress suit is sure to get your little boy, and you, lots of compliments!
